text:
alex: quick sync — Q2 forecast shows we need ~18% more GPU hours if we keep current packing. fragmentation + multi-tenant tail jobs are the culprit
maria: can you share the numbers? the dashboard looked rough but 18% feels high
alex: pasted from capacity-bot summary: avg utilization 62%, fragmentation loss ~14%, peak headroom used 30% during nightly evals
capacity-bot: [auto-report] projected GPU hours for Q2: 1.24M (+18% vs baseline). tail job distribution: 72% <1GPU, 18% 1-2 GPUs, 10% >2 GPUs.
chen: what if we switch to slab-based packing for small jobs + soft-affinity for long-running tenants? reduces fragmentation for tiny slices
sasha: worried about fairness. slab can favor noisy tenants unless we put weighted quotas in place
chen: agree. proposal: slab allocator with tenant weights + preemptible slots for background evals. small config sketch:
alex: drop it here so infra team can iterate:
chen: ```yaml
scheduler:
  packer: slab
  slab_sizes: [0.25, 0.5, 1.0]  # fractions of a GPU for micro jobs
  tenant_fairness: weighted
  preemption:
    enabled: true
    safe_threshold: 0.75  # don't preempt below 75% utilization
    protected_tenants: ["enterprise", "sla-tier"]
```
maria: will that help our QPS-sensitive endpoints? we can't introduce jitter for low-latency routes
chen: soft-affinity means latency routes get placement priority and non-preemptible reservations; micro batch jobs land in slabs and are preemptible
sasha: what about fragmentation from mixed vram requirements (A100 small vram vs H100 large)? slab by fractional GPU works best within same GPU class
alex: we should keep GPU-class-aware pools: small-gpus pool (A100-40/48), large-gpus pool (H100). scheduler routes by model profile
maria: action items?
alex: 1) run A/B in staging with slab packer for low-cost batch cluster (two-week run)
2) add tenant weight controller + preemption safe_threshold toggle
3) update forecasting model to simulate slab packing (need changes in simulator)
sasha: I'll own tenant weight controller PR. tagging @chen for scheduler changes.
capacity-bot: [note] scheduled simulation job `slab-sim-q2` queued (ETA 4h)
maria: small asks: include cost delta estimates and rollback plan in PRs, and ensure observability (per-tenant fragmentation metric)
alex: agreed. add per-tenant fragmentation metric to Redwood Console charts and create alert if fragmentation >10% for 24h
chen: quick perf caveat — slab reduces scheduling latency for small jobs but increases micro-preempt churn. I'll measure token throughput impact in sim
maria: can we cap churn by increasing slab_size for tenants that show high preempt rate?
chen: yes, slab sizes can be dynamic per-tenant in the config
sasha: timeline: incubate in staging next week, canary in low-cost cluster mid-March, wider rollout in early April if sim looks good
alex: thanks everyone. I'll create the tracking ticket and link the sim results when ready. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — ping me once the sim has cost delta so finance can update Q2 forecast
